CustomField.description: Derived: why the job is or is not active right now, and how much of its window is left. Display only.
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(AJO_Enabled__c), "Paused", IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(AJO_StartDate__c)), AJO_StartDate__c > TODAY() ), "Starts " & TEXT(AJO_StartDate__c), IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(AJO_EndDate__c)), AJO_EndDate__c < TODAY() ), "Expired " & TEXT(AJO_EndDate__c), IF( ISBLANK(AJO_EndDate__c), "Active, no end date", "Active, " & TEXT(AJO_EndDate__c - TODAY() + 1) & " day(s) left" ))))
CustomField.label: Window
